text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Crown Prince Hassan, addressing forum on investment in the Mediterranean region, calls for a focus on economic not military values. Discusses with British foreign minister the state of refugees in Jordan and planned association agreement with European Union.
- Joint Qatari-Jordanian statement after visit of Qatari crown prince confirms need to secure the principles of mutual respect and sovereignty.
- King Hussein gets a message of thanks from Saudi King Fahd for congratulating him on 15th anniversary since his accession.
- First batch of Jordanians released from Kuwaiti jail arrive home.
- King Hussein and Queen Noor check preparations for moving children from orphanage into palace. Qatar's crown prince makes donation to Jordanian orphans.
- Prime minister says next six months of peace process are very sensitive.
- Lebanon reopens its borders to Jordanian tomatoes.
- Lawyer's union election today; four candidates standing for union head and 46 to stand on the board.
